title: feat: implement Console Development Roadmap phases 1-9
body:
Addresses the Console Development Roadmap by implementing all 9 phases: NavigationConfig spec compliance across view plugins, metadata API expansion, expression engine wiring, RBAC integration, real-time updates, action system, and offline/PWA support.

### NavigationConfig compliance (Phase 9)

Added `useNavigationOverlay` + `NavigationOverlay` to the 5 non-compliant plugins, matching the existing pattern in plugin-grid and plugin-list:

- **plugin-kanban**: Added `onCardClick` prop threaded through `SortableCard → KanbanColumn → KanbanBoard → ObjectKanban`
- **plugin-calendar**: Wired `navigation.handleClick` into existing `onEventClick`
- **plugin-gantt**: Wired into existing `onTaskClick`
- **plugin-map**: Wired into existing `onMarkerClick`
- **plugin-timeline**: Added click handlers to renderer items (vertical + horizontal), wired `onItemClick` through schema

All 8 view plugins now support the 7 navigation modes (`page`, `drawer`, `modal`, `split`, `popover`, `new_window`, `none`).

### Metadata API (Phase 3)

- Added `getPage?(pageId: string): Promise<any | null>` to `DataSource` interface
- Implemented in `ObjectStackAdapter` with metadata cache

### Console wiring (Phases 1, 2, 5, 6, 8)

- **Expressions**: `ExpressionEvaluator` filters CRUD dialog fields by `visible` expressions with record context
- **Actions**: Toolbar renders actions from `objectDef.actions[]` where `location === 'list_toolbar'`
- **RBAC**: `usePermissions().can()` gates sidebar navigation items and Create button (permissive default when no provider)
- **Real-time**: `useRealtimeSubscription` on `object:{name}` channel triggers `refreshKey` increment
- **Offline**: `useOffline` indicator in AppHeader; fixed `PWAConfig.enabled` in `main.tsx`

```typescript
// NavigationConfig pattern now consistent across all view plugins
const navigation = useNavigationOverlay({
  navigation: schema.navigation,
  objectName: schema.objectName,
  onRowClick,
});
// → navigation.handleClick wired to item click
// → <NavigationOverlay {...navigation}> renders overlay
```

### Test results

All modified plugin tests pass. Kanban `TouchSensor` mock failures and console vite build (hotcrm submodule) are pre-existing.
